lines: I’m in a dilemma
Being my mother’s seed
And my father’s by-blow
Being myself
And acting in accord with my nature
Being in love
And being love in itself.
My mind baffles me at times
Times when I’m healthy of course
Healthy enough to think about why my mind should baffle me in the first place
It baffles me to the extent where I consider my own thoughts
But then
In death, there’s no thoughts
There could be no thought
So as much as I’m baffled, I still need to consider my thoughts
For the little time I have to live, is the only time I have to think
I still have not said why my mind baffles me
I know
Believe me, it is for the best
Because you need not know why I’m baffled by my own mind
For you have thoughts of your own
Think before you die.
The war of knowing yourself supersedes whatever war
Truly knowing yourself
Sincerely venturing into the nooks and crannies of your existence
Honestly deciphering what you really are made of
It, most definitely, constitutes a brutal war.
I believe I am one of the few that gives a shit about who I truly am
I’m not saying you don’t
I’m just saying humans don’t
The art of introspection
One in which you uncover your true story
It saddens me that nobody wants to know
To know who they really are
To understand what they really want
And to believe in what really they need
Humans don’t know their reason for being humans
Herein lies the reason for this poem.
There are times I wish I had no pen in between my fingers
There are times I wish I had no feelings brewing within me
There are times I wish I had no emotions fighting to make themselves known
There are times I wish I had no tears waiting for my heartbreak
There are times I wish I had no mind to think
There are times I wish I had no love, shielding myself from humans
There are times I wish I had no one so as to stop my ever racing thoughts
There are times I wish I had no soul to be able to accept my being baseless
There are times I wish I had no insecurities so I can be louder
There are times I wish I never met you, just for my health
There are times I pray for my death
Just to get you scared.

pages.title: Love or war/ Unfairness of humans

lines: All’s fair in love and war
Consequently,
We are neither in love
Nor at war
Hence,
What are we?
Nothing perhaps?
Just beings that mean nothing to each other?
Beings that are only here for a gain
Whatever gain it might be
Whatever gain could it even be?
Because, what really do we wish to gain
When we are neither loving nor at war
So what exactly do we wish to acquire by conquering
Since there are only two battlefields in life
Obviously so of course
There are two battlefields to life
Love
And War
If we are fighting neither
Who then are we?
Love,
A reaction to a consistent action.
I saw the moon crying
It was 5:30 pm
I wanted to walk past her
I didn’t see a reason for her tears
Just moments from now and it will be her time
She will be known
By the world
I stopped though
She must have sustained an injury
She looked up at me
Eyes tear filled
Nose red
Lips quivering still
Smile shaky
She was beautiful
She could see my question etched around my eyebrows
She chuckled
And she asked a question
Who am I?
I laughed at that
Wildly infact
You must be kidding right?
That’s what I replied
No
No she wasn’t kidding
You’re the freaking moon!
That’s what I exclaimed
She smiled at that
And she replied
Oh yes, I’m the moon
The infamous reflection of another’s purpose.
And then there will come a day
An hour
A minute even
That you’ll be faced with reality
Not because you haven’t been living real life
But because you haven’t been real with yourself
And when that time, day, moment comes
I hope you do not cringe at what you see
I hope you do not regret any action
I hope you do not come to the realization that you’ve yearned for something that someone else wants
I hope you do not close your eyes in shame
I hope you do not realize that you’ve been living another’s life.
I really hope you see yourself
Not the person you believe you are
But the person you actually are.
I got it
I knew I had it
But then I lost it
Lost it?
Can you really ever lose something you loved?
Someone you loved?
Maybe
It leaves you
He leaves you
She leaves you
They leave your mind
And really, when something leaves your mind, can it be retrieved?
Without still the help of that same mind?
My mind wished and begged
For it to retrieve Him
Not my mind
Maybe my heart
What differs the heart from the mind?
I have no bloody idea so don’t even look to me for any help
So it could have been my heart begging
I have this feeling that it is
So my heart begged
It begged my mind to retrieve Him
My mind was scared though
No not my mind
My body was
My flesh was
So scared
Scared?
Fear ?
What really does fear imply?
Isn’t it just the manifestation of the insecurity of the mind?
The mind again
Damn
The mind
The soul
What differs those two?
Please do not look to me for help
You should know that I’m even more confused about myself and my thoughts than the average human
The average human at least pretends
Pretends they know the shit they’re doing
And they comprehend the reason for their decisions
I’m not saying they don’t
Cause really, who the fuck am I to know how convincing pretense can get?
I’m not sure I remember the reason for this poem again
If I can call this a poem that is
I’m not sure I know it’s message
It’s purpose
Maybe it’s purpose doesn’t comprise sending a message
Maybe it sends the question to a message
If you’re thinking deeply at what I just said, you’re alone
Cause I’m doing no such thing with you.
NB: if you didn ’ t understand shit, that ’ s ok. We ’ re not all as mentally stable as you are.
Very loudly
He screams actually
When you imagine a being other than human speaking to you
The first thing that comes to mind is a calm and cool voice
Almost a whisper
But not the devil
No
With blood shot eyes
And knotted fists
He screams
He barks
He slaps
He pushes
He kicks
He suffocates
He kills
Yet he could swear that he loves me.
You might know this
You might not
But a very easy yet tasking way of knowing who you really are
Is knowing your purpose
Purpose
The reason for living
As much as most of us might doubt it
We all have a purpose
A reason why we are living
And living according to that reason is the only way we can both fulfill our purpose and still live fully
Some forget that though
That they have a reason for life
And then they make the mistake of living according to a particular standard or mindset
Not realizing that they should live
Actually live
What is your purpose
How can you know your purpose
Why do you have a purpose
When can you say your purpose has been fulfilled
Interesting questions
That can only be answered by your inbuilt qualities
Qualities and characteristics that can only be felt and understood by you
What makes you you
What makes you lose yourself
What do you yearn for deeply
What distracts you from life itself
What ignites emotions in you
What gets you thinking for a long time
What can you lose yourself to, I ask again
Therein lies yourself and your purpose
The soul is yearning
All the time
It yearns for something
Something satisfactory
Something beneficial to the tee
Something that provokes peace
That causes gratification at the most
And until that happens,
The soul will never quit searching .
There’s bad news of course;
The physical
The literal
The material
The social
The emotional
And some other human
Will never bring your soul contentedness
You wish to follow your heart
But I,
I wish to nurture my mind.
What exactly goes on in their mind
Like what do they think everyday
What do they wake up to
And sleep to
How do they even reason
People that believe they’re in love
Cause give me a break
You couldn ’ t think up something unless you command your mind to think it up or you’ve reveled in whatever thing it is till your mind has no choice but to go back there
Something like doing a particular thing over and over again
So much so that your mind becomes a captive to it
That’s what I think being in love feels like
Or
An emotion
Maybe like anger?
Something you can switch on and off of course
Depending on the strength of your mind or capability to control your emotion
Anger
A reaction to an action
An action that initiated your reaction
So is love
Not love though
Romance
Romantic love
Whatever
So romantic love being a reaction to a certain action
Of course yes
You have to ponder on the actions and inactions of a lover before you can conclude that you’re in love with that person
Therefore your reason for love depends on the actions of your lover
Emptiness is a virus
One that spreads
Never too slowly, no
You seek
And search
And beckon
With no hope of being found
Being filled
Being fulfilled
And when I can reach him,
I reach for him;
And pour myself over him;
Bathing him under the moonlit sky.
For its all I can do to assure him.
But with sunrise comes his absence.
And as I soak in my sorrows;
My tears conjure him,
For days. Weeks.
But when he comes to me again,
I drip for him.
The emotions you create
The feelings you conjure
The imaginations you inspire
How have I not learnt this lesson
Over and over I keep allowing myself be hurt
Hurt more than I can bare
Well to think of it
If I couldn’t bare it, I wouldn’t allow it
I hate that I’m me
I hate that I’m complacent
I hate that I’m forgiving
I hate that I’m understanding
I hate that I’m loving
I hate that I have a heart and a soul
I hate that I allow you to know all these
I hate that I’m me.
Scourged from all the pain life threw at me
Weak in the knees from affliction
Tired from the undue punishments
It is a thing of concern that I do not grab at a life line whenever I’ m thrown one
I tell myself every time I miss it that it was only a figment of my desperate imagination
But I know deep down that I don’t know nothing about my need
I don’t know if I need
I don’t know if I have a right to need
Being hurt so much that mere desires become far fetched
This is the worst kind of living
Believe me when I say it is.

pages.title: The concept of freedom is unfathomable

lines: It’s almost inconceivable;
To be free yet liable.
I wonder why they consider me trustable;
When by the things I say and do, I should be proclaimed incapable.
Here I am, an acclaimed bubble,
Yet I act like I am dependable.
I’m at the verge of death, for my freedom seems unattainable.
I wish to scream, run and reach for the unachievable,
But it’s so hard when my mindset is indictable,
For my lack of aspiration and my fear of not being durable.
Sincerely, my freedom is somewhat immeasurable,
For it is inconsistent and so damn pliable.
Well all I’m trying to do is sit and be comfortable,
For the concept of freedom is fucking doubtable.
The ache is indescribable.
That pang of pain that comes whenever you tell me you do not want me;
You do not want me more than the way you already have me:
And no, It does not hurt me because I want you more than the way I have you,
For I do not.
It burns because I know there’s more to offer;
I have more to offer,
I have a lot more to give,
So as to receive more from you.
But your decision is clear.
You will never give me a chance;
I’d never have the chance to prove that I can be more;
More than what you expect me to be for you.
Today,
Mama didn’t go to church
It’s a Sunday
Yet mama didn’t wake up early
It’s the Lord’s day
Yet mama didn’t heat some water
It’s the day for believers
Still, Mama didn’t wear her Sunday’s best
It’s the day to celebrate Jesus
And Mama didn’t care to shout at us
Its the day to raise Holy hands
And mama still hasn’t driven the car to her favorite place
Mama is still under the blankets
Head deep infact
Mama isn’t sick though
But she’s tired
Not tired of being a believer, no
But TIRED
Life and its choices just caught up with her
And watching her right now?
Seeing as she’s beaten down by her own decisions?
Tears trickle down my eyes
I want to help
I really do
But how can the heart broken lean on the depressed
It’s the thrill
It’s definitely the adrenaline
I needed coitus
At its best, at its greatest peak
There is a need
When you realize just how near your death is
All is fair in Love and War,
My lovely warrior says
Love?
War?
Here I am trying to think up ways to liken these two.
Oh but you cannot fault me,
For they are direct opposites.
Love builds.
War destroys.
Humans build only to destroy
Ah!
Here it is
A striking similarity
This being, human.
The thing about living is just that
Living
In the general sense of the word
It ’ s a draining exercise that we have no choice but corroborate with
Except of course, the choice of death
Which shouldn’t be such an abominable choice
For with death comes rest
Rest from it all
Rest from living
From loving
From him.
Is having a free mind
Not still
Subjecting yourself to a particular state of mind
There is a small town
At the outskirts of our town
Not so small, I presume
Since it has such a vast land
The lands were so vast it accommodates them
The lot of them.
Whenever I walk its fields
I feel the coldness
The nothingness
The hopelessness
It always comes with a pang of guilt though
The guilt of living amongst death
The guilt of breathing in a wasteland
The guilt of hope where there is no hope
And I smile
For I know
That soon enough
I will be it’s jolly companion.
I get above myself
Sometimes I do
I think
More like I imagine
Things that are way bigger than I am
Is that a good thing?
It can be
It’s a beautiful escape for one
So enticing
So much so that I lose myself
To an extent in which I am not aware of the occurrences around me
Is that a good thing?
Maybe
But then again
Isn’t it better to be more in touch with your imagination to enact them
To actually see your dreams come to play in reality
That’s something to be excited about
But
Is that a good thing?
It could be
Oh but there are times that I just get so emotional
Knowing how badly I want certain things and actually thinking about how to get them
I get sad
Sometimes, depressed
But then again
That should work as an encouragement
Sadness as a reason for determination
Is that a good thing?
The emptiness brings an ache
So hollow it is that the nothingness of it causes pain
An unbearable sting of hurt, is what it is.
I inhaled all the oxygen I could
As quickly as possible
Considering my fear
That I will perish from the soreness I sense
A precedented one of course
The air filled the cavity
Somewhat easing my anguish
But as the Creator made it
I have to exhale
And as I let out the air
I succumbed.
Rise above death Dee
For death is a distraction from life
From living.
There are beauties to your death, yes
But there’s achievements to your living.
Therefore, when death raises its pretty head
Smile directly at it
Actually, laugh in its face
Make a humor of it
For without a handshake from you
It cannot pull you in.
What does it mean to have freedom of the mind?
How can your mind be free?
We all believe to a certain extent that our mind is free
We ’ re free from certain things that enslaves some humans ’ minds
Freedom of the mind
Freedom from the mind
Which of them brings the most contentment
Which of them provides more superior results
What even differs both?
I’ve said this before and I’ll gladly say it again
Look not to me for help
But then again
Think about it
Like think deeply about it
What does it mean for your mind to be free?
Don ’ t you think freedom of the mind comes from a freedom from the mind?
Come on
Don’t give up on your imagination
Just think, imagine, dream
Your mind is a captor and you’re the captive
You might say I’m not saying the truth
And you might be right
But your mind provides the most authentic enslavement
So tell me
Don ’ t you think freedom of the mind comes from a freedom from the mind?
I want answers
Of course I do
Answers to everything really
Because some say their mind is free
They’re wild at heart
But can one really be genuinely free from the mind?
When one thinks about it
There’s a cost to be paid to be actually free from and of the mind
The cost of honesty
I think
I’m not sure
There might be worst penalties to face
But my “mind” can only fathom honesty at the moment
Thus, honesty.
When you start avoiding the people that really knows you and are real to you
I hope you come to the realization that, in that moment, you’ve lost yourself.
There’s gonna be someone
A him
A her
Some they
That’s gonna oppose you
Hell we are so focused on not wanting any type of opposition that we forget that we ’ re limiting ourselves to a bloody social expectation
It’s funny
We spend so much time convincing ourselves of our
“uniqueness” that we forget that it’s such a rampant thing that’s done
Damn
We convince ourselves that we crazy whilst the whole world is normal
But approximately 10 million of us have told ourselves just that
Sometimes we forget though
That’s cause it’s hard keeping up a facade
It’s friggin hard keeping up any facade
But I’m gonna keep mine up
Maybe it’s cause I believe that’s where my happiness lies
I’m crazy, I know
10 million of us know
At first I was talking about the opposing of opposition
I’m sorry
I tend to get above myself
So opposition
I believe it’s healthy
10 million of us think so, actually
But that don’t mean we embrace it
And that’s wrong
At least 2 million of us think it’s wrong
Then there’s some of us that actually readily hugs it
That’s 10 of us, maybe
I’m not so sure
It’s 9 of them and one of my imagination
Damn
She looked with confidence
All the while frightened
Hopeless and anxious
The future does that to her
She’s left drained
From thinking, assuming, aspiring, praying
Looking back is hard
Reverting to old thoughts and decisions
I’m always very consumed with hate
Hate for myself
Because for some bloody reason
I can’t seem to stop regretting my actions.
Do you believe?
Do you believe in redemption?
It’s so funny
I think so much about how eagerly I want to be redeemed,
But still relish in my transgressions.
I ache for a breakthrough,
But still wallow in my current situation.
I look forward to a bright future,
But still fight with past traumas.
So yes, I do believe in redemption,
For I understand it’s existence;
I just do not know if I could stretch my hand in its direction.
Most times, I feel like I’ve lived and lived enough;
I feel like my existence has reached its resting point;
I feel like my purpose has drawn its conclusion;
I feel like life as I know it has been determined.
In times like these, all the wells which lay within burst at their seams;
They wish to implode with all their hidden virility;
They wish to exude themselves and parade on the lines of my pain stricken face;
They wish to be one with the kitchen floors.
And as time passes, i can only lay in reverence of the strength of emotions that were percolated;
I lay in awe of the feelings I held under lock and key;
I lay in amusement at how foolish I feel;
I lay in rest.
Whenever I put pen to paper
I give it all up
All the anger
The frustration
The hate
The love
The uncertainty
The insecurity
The lust.
I give it all up into words
For if I allow it remain as feelings
I might burn to ashes
So I write and write
And cry
And write
And die.
There was a time I loved
There was a time i yearned for love
There was a time I mistook love
And here we are,
At a time where I cannot fathom love
There was a time I wanted love
There was a time I begged to be loved
There was a time I knew to love
And here we are,
At a time where I’m willing to escape love
There was a time I understood love
There was a time I wished love upon myself
There was a time I believed love
And here we are,
At a time where I’ve lived up love
There was a time I claimed I was in love
There was a time I wondered about love
There was a time I waited patiently on love
And here we are,
At a time where love is far fetched
I have loved before;
And I want to no more,
For my heart is sore
And my spirits, a bore.
I could love again;
Why abstain?
For all of my pain,
Has been washed by the rain.
I am in love today.
Yes, I went astray.
For like the sun with its ray,
I beam like the heaven’s bay.
Woe to love, my dears.
It has been executed, all my fears.
For I lie on the floor in tears,
Because my whole life has become a drear.
I look deep into his eyes;
His soul bears his true feelings,
Something he can never get his mind to corroborate.
There’s been a war.
To an extent, I understood his hesitation,
But to a greater extent, I hated it.
The feeling of being left out:
Left out from his inner battles;
Oh how I wanted to stand rooted by his side,
With a sword and armor,
Venturing to the heat of the war,
Wading off soldiers,
Killing demons,
Massacring the toughest battalion.
And even if I meet with death,
Where the demons and life intersect.
I shall proudly walk with her.
I’d look back and smile at him,
As though I survived.
Why?
Because dear, I shall kiss death just so you can embrace life.
He promised love
Swore on his great granny’s grave
That he would show me how exquisite the true feeling of love is
I still smile thinking about it
How, really, did he intend to do that?
Kill himself perhaps?
Love is insatiable, dear
Love is so insatiable.
I intend to go through it all
Oh but not by myself
But by others too
To fully grasp life
To fully understand my existence.
Whenever I think of the end;
I envision a goddamn Blues concert.
What do I want from life?
Are my wants the same things I expect?
Are they the exact things I even hope for?
Why do I even want something from life?
Life in itself is already a giving, a beautiful gift
Do I wish to generate more requests after being gifted?
I wish for life. Life as it is
To live fully
Is that even a possibility?
Or will it remain just a wish?
To whom much is given, much is expected
I wasn’t given much
But damn was a lot of things expected of me
It has become a duty; an obligation
To give. And give all.
I wished to receive
To receive more
I wanted more out of people
More than they can give
More than they wish to give
And here lies the beginning of disappointments.
I understand that I have to give to receive
That is why I gave
I gave it all
I gave my mind and soul
I gave my Spirit;
Oh why else wouldn’t I give my body
Just because I longed to receive
But never, Never have I received as I wish to
There’s a pleasure to it
I felt a rush; no pang of guilt
I wanted to give it all
Even with the knowledge that I might never receive
All because I wanted it all gone
I wanted nothing more to give
I wanted to empty myself
I wanted them all to know that I am but nothing
I am just a piece of human flesh
So I gave all the aspects of me that I could fathom
I want you to have it all
For this is all I can ever offer
My breasts, my soul, my derrière and my mind
Nothing is left
I have prostituted it all.
The more we have knowledge of it
The more endless it becomes.

pages.title: To be present. I am present. Aren’t I?

lines: Being present is one of the most underrated things
To be able to find yourself when you’re lost
To be able to rise when you’ve made room with ashes
To be able to stand whilst you feel like lying six feet under
To be able to snap yourself awake when eternal sleep lurks closely
To be able to fight when the blood and water has dissipated from your body
To be able to survive when you’ve been cast down a million times
To be awake while dreaming
To be able to smile when your inner battles push at your barriers
To be able to dance when your feet are mismatched
To be able to sing when your throat aches from unshed tears
To be able to cry when your eyes beg to just be shut
To be able to laugh when nothing makes sense
To be able to write when your fingers shake uncontrollably
To be able to listen when your ears can only take silence
To be able to love when you still hurt
To be able to hope when the end seems so close
To be able to speak
To be able to speak at all
To walk. To just walk
To be able to stare; to look at something for long period of time without the darkness taking over
To be able to see life
To be present
To be here
To wander
To date
To reverberate life
Life in all its fullness
To not go blank; I sincerely do not want to be lost anymore
To remember
To have moments; Moments that might be made in minutes but last for years
To be alive
And awake.

pages.title: Just a little bit of my heart.

lines: If my feelings were an empty cup aching to be filled;
It shall remain empty till the passing of time.
If it were a man in need of a home;
He shall die from the cold of the night’s air.
If it were a woman that yearns for a child;
She shall be buried without knowing the warmth of a baby ’ s skin.
If it were a dog in need of a master;
It shall struggle for scruples till its sad end.
If it were a hunger that needed to be fed;
It shall clench its belly and lie in wait for its death.
If it were a locked door;
It shall grow old and never know the feeling of a key inserted into it.
If it were a sex starved woman;
She shall pleasure herself until her fingers ache.
If it were an unfruitful village;
It shall grow extinct.
I’m standing here naked;
Stripped out of all that is within me and without.
At this point.
Right now.
I’m nothing;
Just a visual representation of dust that was breathed into.
Still standing naked;
Naked enough for you to see what is within and without.
Right here.
This moment.
I’m nothing;
Just an illustration of spirit, soul and flesh.
I am without clothes again, my dear;
For the clothes hide the insecurities that I wish to expose to you.
Here on out,
From this minute.
I’m nothing;
Just a person who yearns to be loved and to love without limits.
I love you.
And I really hope you love me in spite of my nothingness.
The promise is a gift of forever
Darling, I give this to you
I look into your eyes
And doing this makes me reassured
I know that the fear and anxiety of forever are swept away
I feel your touch
And doing this makes me so excited
I know that the hell of discontentment is forever swept away.
The feeling of contentment and satisfaction
I believe
Is one of the most far fetched emotions
How can one be truly satisfied
How can one be content with life
Life cannot give us all we would ever want
So how do you invoke contentment
I have a theory
Every single person that claims satisfaction is only happy with their present circumstance
Dear, Satisfaction is impossible to conceive
And discontentment is inevitable.
When I lay in your arms
Letting down every guard of mine
The concept does not seem as unreachable.
There’s a black shadow
Lingering just behind my shoulders
Whenever I turn to have a peek at it
It makes a run for it
No. I’m lying.
It doesn’t
“It”, I refer to her like I do not know who she is
She doesn’t run
She stares right back at me
With the look of hate and disgust.
Why does she look at me in such a manner, you may ask
It is because she sees through me
She sees the debris
She perceives the stench
And she feels the dirt
And oh, it all makes her skin crawl.
I try to speak with her
To justify myself, probably
To see reason with her in the least
To make her understand
But speaking to her only makes me listen to myself
And listening to myself only makes me feel the exact way she feels about me.
I hate myself!
Hate is a rather harsh word
But I can’t help it
I fucked up
I fucked up
I FUCKED UP
I’m having a fucking psychotic break.
I gave way to the tears
I wish I had allowed it earlier
It soothes
It cleanses
It rejuvenates.
Humans think crying is a show of courage
I do not agree
It is a display of courage
The courage to accept
The bravery to move on.
My dear child
Whether biological, spiritual or by love
Whoever you may be reading this
There’s one thing I need you to know
About me
I knew the truth
The whole truth
If I had any shortcomings
Or lived a lie in whatever way
Just know that I knew the truth
But as it is
Knowing the truth and living the truth are worlds apart
And only by choice can you abide by any of them.
Take with you a troop of soldiers
Fight with them
Fight for them
And when you die
Because you surely will
You shall live on.
